Junior Architect
REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor degree in architecture or interior design
Architect / Interior designer with minimum 2 years experience in design and build projects
Strong technical drawing and conceptual design skills
Proficient in AutoCAD, SketchUp and Revit
Good communication and project management skills
Understanding of building codes and regulations
Strong presentation and visualization skills
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop conceptual designs and design development for residential and office projects.
Prepare working drawings and 3D modelling for space planning.
Coordinate with suppliers to source material specifications, furniture and lighting.
Plan and monitor the project timeline from start to handover.
